provider_decision.rationale: GDPR-compliant, EU data residency option, dedicated transactional stream, magic-link delivery optimized, free tier 100 emails/month, strong deliverability reputation, SPF/DKIM auto-provisioned per server.

alternatives.note: Developer-friendly, EU region, but newer reputation pool
Mature, EU region available, but more complex pricing
Cheapest at scale, but requires more DNS setup and reputation warm-up

dns_records.purpose: SPF — authorize Postmark to send from pariscomedy.com
dns_records.where_to_add: Cloudflare DNS → pariscomedy.com zone → Add TXT record

dns_records.value: (provided by Postmark after domain verification — unique per account)
dns_records.where_to_add: Cloudflare DNS → Add TXT record with DKIM value from Postmark dashboard

dns_records.value: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@pariscomedy.com; ruf=mailto:dmarc@pariscomedy.com; sp=reject; adkim=r; aspf=r
dns_records.purpose: DMARC — policy: quarantine unauthenticated mail; reports to dmarc@pariscomedy.com
Return-path / bounce handling — Postmark tracks bounces

verification_checklist: Log in to Postmark → Sender Signatures → Add domain pariscomedy.com
Postmark generates DKIM TXT record → add to Cloudflare
Add SPF TXT to Cloudflare (merge with any existing SPF record)
Run: dig TXT pariscomedy.com | grep spf
Send test email to a real inbox via Postmark API with test token
fail_closed_rule: If EMAIL_SEND_REAL=true but POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN is missing/placeholder, mailer.send() raises ConfigurationError. Default EMAIL_SEND_REAL=false means no real sending.
